name: application-cash-drawer-summary
title: Cash Drawer Summary
description: Expected-vs-counted cash drawer reconciliation with a computed signed variance, highlighted as balanced/over/short — distinct from comparison-stat-pair, which is a generic head-to-head 'vs' comparison with no over/under/balanced discrepancy semantics.
useWhen: Reconciling a physical cash drawer against expected register totals at end of shift.
You want the variance and its direction (over/short) computed live from the two totals.
A small tolerance should still count as 'Balanced' rather than flagging rounding noise.
avoidWhen: You're comparing two arbitrary metrics with no over/under/balanced meaning — use comparison-stat-pair instead.
You need a full itemized cash breakdown by denomination — pair this with a separate denomination counter.
There's no expected total to compare against — a plain counted-amount display is simpler.
responsiveBehavior: The expected/counted cells sit in a two-column grid that remains side-by-side down to narrow container widths; the variance banner spans full width below.
accessibility: The variance banner carries role='status' so a live recount announces its outcome to assistive tech.
Balanced/Over/Short states use both a distinct color and explicit text label, never color alone.
Negative variance is rendered with an explicit minus sign and 'Short' label, not just a red number.

variants.title: Cash drawer summary
variants.description: A drawer $4.75 short of its $412.00 expected total after a $407.25 count, in the Short state, on a light surface.
accessibility: Variance is computed as counted minus expected, not hand-typed independently of the two totals.

variants.title: Cash drawer summary (Dark)
variants.description: The same short-drawer reconciliation, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Variance banner colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
